name: phosphatase and tensin homolog

function.text: PTEN encodes a tumor-suppressor phosphatase that counteracts PI3K signaling by dephosphorylating phosphatidylinositol lipid messengers, thereby restraining AKT pathway activation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cowden syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Leiomyosarcoma; Cutaneous melanoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: PTEN encodes a tumor-suppressor phosphatase that counteracts PI3K signaling by dephosphorylating phosphatidylinositol lipid messengers, thereby restraining AKT pathway activation.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cowden syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PTEN have been reported in endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium, prostate adenocarcinoma, and prostate.
